meta.title: System Documentation & Webhook API | Sitepow Store
meta.description: Sitepow Store Webhook API documentation. Real-time order and payment notifications with HMAC-SHA256 signature verification code examples.

hero.title: Webhook API Integration Guide
hero.description: Receive real-time notifications when new orders are created, payments succeed, or orders are cancelled to seamlessly integrate with your inventory, game top-up automation, or CRM.

steps.step1Desc: Specify an HTTPS URL on your server in store settings and select the events you wish to receive.
steps.step2Desc: Sitepow sends the {header} header so you can verify authenticity using HMAC-SHA256.
steps.step3Desc: Your server must respond with a 200 OK within 5 seconds to confirm receipt.

events.title: Supported Event Types
events.createdDesc: Dispatched immediately when a customer checks out via storefront or POS.
events.paidDesc: Dispatched when order payment is confirmed (ideal for game top-ups, code delivery, or digital goods automation).
events.cancelledDesc: Dispatched when an order is cancelled or expired, allowing you to restore stock in your system.

headers.title: HTTP Request Headers
headers.signatureDesc: Timestamp and HMAC signature for cryptographic verification
headers.deliveryDesc: Unique delivery attempt ID (for idempotency and deduplication)

bestPractices.title: Best Practices & Retry Policy
bestPractices.fast200Desc: Webhook timeout is 5 seconds. If your processing involves external APIs or sending emails, respond with HTTP 200 immediately and push the task into a background queue (e.g., Redis, BullMQ, Celery).
bestPractices.idempotencyDesc: In case of network hiccups, the system may retry sending the event. Store X-Sitepow-Delivery or event.id in your database to ensure you do not process duplicate events.
bestPractices.retryDesc: If your server returns 4xx, 5xx, or times out, Sitepow retries with exponential backoff up to 5 times (after 1m, 5m, 30m, 2h, and 6h).
bestPractices.autoDisableDesc: If an endpoint fails more than 50 consecutive times, it is temporarily paused and an alert is sent to your store dashboard.
